## Featured Projects

### 2. SplitRx
- **Description**: Security-first medical prescription platform designed to eliminate prescription fraud, unauthorized tampering, identity theft, and medical data leaks.
- **Technologies**: Next.js, TypeScript, Express.js, PostgreSQL
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/genzipher1-0-codestormers/SplitRx

### 3. AgroSense
- **Description**: Agricultural intelligence platform delivering real-time weather alerts, commodity market pricing analytics, and automated crop risk advisory models for farmers.
- **Technologies**: Spring Boot, React, JavaScript, MySQL
- **Live Demo**: https://agrof-repo.vercel.app/

### 4. CashMaster 6688
- **Description**: AI-powered embedded hardware system capable of real-time recognition, classification, and mechanical sorting of Sri Lankan currency notes using edge computer vision.

- **Source Code**: https://github.com/DileepaPRA/Group_Project_CashMaster_6688

### 5. Chef Claude

- **Technologies**: React, Google Gemini API, Express.js, Tailwind CSS
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/DileepaPRA/Chef-Claude

### 6. ForeGoal — FIFA 2026 Prediction Engine

- **Technologies**: Python, Streamlit, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/DileepaPRA/ForeGoal
